quick_deep_screen.training_budget: 1 seed, 2 epochs, 12x downsample; screening not final benchmark

evidence.fast_information_gate: Multinomial held-animal gate independently found 19/19 relational gains at all three horizons.

directed_relation_graph.interpretation: Correct time-aligned partner state and directed source-target geometry carry transferable information about future mouse social behavior beyond focal-mouse state or distribution-matched time-shuffled partner channels.
directed_relation_graph.implementation: Persistent entity tokens + directed relation edges remain in the default SWM v2 core.

neural_stream.interpretation: Current network activity is useful for predicting future network activity, but does not provide a stable cross-animal increment for the next coarse social behavior under this dataset. Brain dynamics should therefore align to social world state without being assumed identical to the behavioral policy state.
neural_stream.implementation: Behavior/social core is primary. Neural stream receives stop-gradient core context and learns future neural dynamics/alignment. Neural-to-behavior readout is diagnostic/optional and requires dataset-specific held-animal evidence before promotion.

multi_agent_group_state.implementation: Self-supervised future entity + future pair dynamics with sparse chase auxiliary and light-context token.

next_gate.name: Stage30 external-pretraining -> held-SOE transfer
next_gate.required: Externally pretrained entity/relation encoder must beat identical scratch SWM v2 on held-SOE animals, especially low-data adaptation, while losing the advantage under wrong-social/no-social/pair-shuffle controls.
